notes.value: Full-Year Pacing Guide, AP Cybersecurity Teacher Bundle
Each lesson = its teaching days + 1 quiz day. Lab days are spread through each unit. Each unit ends with a cumulative test.
21 teach + 4 quiz-and-lab + 1 capstone lab + 2 project + test = 29
20 teach + 6 quiz-and-lab + 2 project + test + semester final = 30
15 teach + 4 quiz-and-lab + 1 capstone lab + 2 project + test = 23
143 lesson-days, about 29 weeks at 5 lesson-days per week
Each lesson lab is paired with that lesson quiz on one day. Labs run 20-30 minutes, so a quiz plus a lab fills one period.
About 5 weeks for AP review before a mid-May exam on a traditional schedule.
Unit 2, 4, and 5 projects and the Semester 1 Final are reserved days, not yet delivered. Units 1 and 3 projects are live. Use reserved days as reteach until they ship.
Threat Defense Report runs AFTER the AP exam and doubles as the second-semester final. Not counted in the 143.
Assign the unit study guide as homework and review in the period before the test. This buys a week of AP review.
Run the Threat Defense Report after the exam, not before. Protect review time.
Not scheduled separately. Fold device-analysis FRQ practice into the AP review block.
If your short period runs full length, treat it as 2 lesson-days and the plan compresses ~3 weeks.
